purpose: Five monochrome Act Dock logo concepts for selection. Not applied to the app.

concepts.name: 1 · Docked Play
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design a premium original logo option for Act Dock, a desktop developer tool that runs local CI/CD pipelines and exposes tools for AI agents. Flat black ink on a clean pure white square presentation canvas, generous whitespace. One large master symbol centered above a smaller beautifully kerned wordmark reading exactly 'Act Dock'. Confident contemporary industrial software identity; remarkable, simple silhouette that works at 24px. Carefully balanced negative space, mathematically intentional proportions, vector-like crisp edges. No colors, gradients, shadows, 3D, mockups, textures, mascots, stock clipart, watermarks, taglines, labels, extra words, or multiple concepts. This is one independent logo choice, not a contact sheet. Direction: DOCKED PLAY. A bold, sculptural U-shaped docking cradle supports and partly encloses a forward play triangle. Resolve cradle and triangle into one compact, ownable, visually interlocking mark with a clear negative-space channel. The triangle feels actively docking, not a generic media player button. Slightly rounded outer corners, precision angular internal cuts. Custom clean medium-weight sans-serif wordmark.
